column3: NASB follows the critical text; it renders “comes” as “will come” and “fully” as “full well.”
NASB follows the critical text without “for”; “security” is rendered “safety,” and “labor pains” is “birth pangs.”
NASB follows the critical text; “watch” is rendered “be alert.”
NASB renders “implore” as “request,” “to know” as “appreciate,” and “admonishing” as “give you instruction.”
NASB renders “super overexcessively” as “very highly” and “be at peace” as “Live in peace.”
NASB renders “pursue” as “seek after” and adds “men.”
NASB follows the critical text (“But”); it adds “carefully.”
NASB renders “completely” as “entirely” and “entirely” as “complete,” and restructures the verse.
NASB renders “will do it” as “will bring it to pass.”
NASB has no “also,” which the critical text includes.
NASB follows the critical text without “holy”; it adds “have.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Amen” and the Textus Receptus subscription.
